description: RAG evaluation dataset for Kliniczny Asystent AI. No real patient data. Questions are generic clinical tasks used to measure retrieval quality.
notes: expected_doc_id: fill in with the real UUID from your docs table after uploading the corresponding guideline.
expected_doc_keywords: used as a fallback hit check when expected_doc_id is null (title substring match, case-insensitive).
answerable=true means: a correctly indexed guideline SHOULD produce >=1 chunk above the retrieval threshold.
answerable=false means: no indexed guideline is expected to match; system should return flag=uncertain via no-source fallback.
